title: TV
description: A mid-sized Sony color television sits across from the couch.
details:
The Trinitron still produces a surprisingly sharp picture. Late-night movies, MTV broadcasts, local news, pirated VHS tapes, cheap horror films, overacted sci-fi, commercials promising electronic futures — the set has seen all of it. The Panasonic VCR underneath hums softly when powered on, filling the apartment with that familiar warm electronic presence unique to late-night television.
Both devices were inherited from the apartment's previous tenants.
takeFailure: You have some problems sometimes, but not severe enough to start hauling a television set to a pawn shop. Especially when the guy who technically still owns the TV also technically still owns the apartment you're illegally subletting.
